architecture.topology: Single public control-plane endpoint. Execution nodes initiate outbound HTTPS long-poll connections to the control plane. No inbound listener, port-forward, or per-device public tunnel is required.
architecture.routing_rule: Login device never selects execution device. Project binding selects device; task inherits immutable task-device binding; all task-scoped routed operations resolve through that binding.

device_identity.device_id: Server-generated stable ID prefix dev_, assigned after successful pairing and persisted by both control plane and node.
device_identity.device_name: Human-readable label only; never used as routing identity.
device_identity.implementation_dependency: cryptography (Ed25519 support); observed available version at prelock host: 48.0.0
device_identity.private_key_rule: Private key never leaves execution node and is never logged. File permissions are owner-only/best-effort Windows ACL.
device_identity.public_key_fingerprint: sha256(raw Ed25519 public key bytes), lowercase hex
device_identity.key_rotation: Deferred; a revoked key/device cannot be un-revoked or silently rotated.

pairing.pairing_code: At least 144 bits random URL-safe secret shown exactly once.
pairing.proof_of_possession: Initial pair request includes Ed25519 public key and a signature over canonical pairing payload; gateway verifies signature with submitted public key plus one-time pairing code.
pairing.result: Gateway creates dev_* identity, route_generation=1, state ONLINE; node persists device_id/public origin/key fingerprint.
pairing.re_pair_revoked: Forbidden. Pair as a new device identity.
pairing.code_file_rule: UTF-8 file containing exactly one pairing code line. CLI reads it once, trims CR/LF only, then must delete the file before making the network pairing request. If deletion fails, pairing aborts PAIRING_CODE_FILE_DELETE_FAILED.
pairing.code_nonce: Server-generated random URL-safe nonce stored in device_pairings.code_nonce.
pairing.code_derivation: Clear pairing code is deterministically re-derived only while that exact unused, unexpired pairing row exists. Clear code is never persisted in SQLite, operation results, logs, or events.
pairing.pair_begin_replay: Same successful device_pair_begin operation may re-derive and return the same clear pairing code while unused/unexpired. If pairing is already used, replay returns pairing_id/device_id/status=USED without clear code.
pairing.secret_startup_rule: Create key atomically once. If an unused unexpired pairing exists but device-pairing.key is missing/unreadable, startup fails STARTUP_FATAL_PAIRING_KEY_MISSING.

auth_replay_protection.signature: Ed25519 over canonical UTF-8 bytes; signature base64url without padding.
auth_replay_protection.nonce_uniqueness: UNIQUE(device_id, nonce) in central DB; duplicates rejected DEVICE_REPLAY.
auth_replay_protection.route_generation: Every revoke or future explicit re-pair generation change invalidates older signed traffic. Exact generation must match current device row.
auth_replay_protection.transport_security: HTTPS required for non-loopback node traffic. Node trusts configured public origin TLS certificate chain; no plaintext remote node transport.
auth_replay_protection.server_response_auth: HTTPS origin authentication plus command envelope binding to device_id/route_generation/request_hash. No separate server-signature layer in v1.

device_states.ONLINE: Valid signed heartbeat/poll observed within 60 seconds and route generation matches.
device_states.OFFLINE: No valid signed device request within 60 seconds. New routed mutations/jobs fail DEVICE_OFFLINE and are never reassigned.
device_states.REVOKED: Owner explicitly revoked device. All further signed node traffic is rejected DEVICE_REVOKED. State is terminal.
device_states.offline_transition: ONLINE -> OFFLINE is automatic by timeout.
device_states.online_recovery: OFFLINE -> ONLINE only when same device key/device_id/route_generation reconnects with valid signed request.
device_states.revoked_transition: ONLINE/OFFLINE -> REVOKED only via owner-authenticated device_revoke.
revoke_effects: cancel QUEUED not-yet-leased commands with DEVICE_REVOKED
mark LEASED commands IN_DOUBT because side effect may already exist
never move projects/tasks to another device

transport.poll_response: 204 when no command; otherwise exactly one command envelope.
transport.delivery_semantics: At-least-once delivery to the same bound device until durable result; node-local command_id journal makes side effects idempotent.
transport.redelivery: LEASED command with lost response may return to QUEUED only after delivery lease expiry and before command_expires_at_ms. It is redelivered only to the same device_id.
transport.node_duplicate_rule: Same command_id + same request_hash returns persisted node result without executing again. Same command_id + different hash => COMMAND_CONFLICT.
transport.mutation_expiry_rule: Node refuses a mutating command after command_expires_at_ms. Gateway also refuses dispatch when current task lease epoch no longer matches the command.
transport.timeout_result: If routed command remains durable but unfinished beyond gateway wait, return/raise DEVICE_COMMAND_PENDING keyed by command_id; same operation_id resumes/replays rather than creating a new command.
transport.operation_command_key: Mutation commands are uniquely identified by (operation_id, operation_step), allowing one high-level operation to persist multiple ordered routed commands.
transport.operation_step_rule: operation_step starts at 0 and is prospectively fixed by each workflow. PROJECT_REGISTER_ON_DEVICE uses step 0=PROJECT_PROBE and step 1=PROJECT_BIND.
transport.command_creation_idempotency: Same operation_id + operation_step + request_hash reuses the existing command. Same operation_id + operation_step with a different request_hash => COMMAND_CONFLICT.

project_binding.path_semantics: projects.root_rel is relative to that device's MCP_NODE_ROOT, not gateway filesystem.
register_protocol: operation step 0: route PROJECT_PROBE to device to canonicalize path under MCP_NODE_ROOT and detect GIT/NON_GIT
persist project + project_device_binding only after successful probe
operation step 1: route PROJECT_BIND so node persists project_id->root mapping
operation succeeds only after both central and node binding records agree
project_binding.existing_project_bind: Allowed only when project has no non-terminal tasks, no non-terminal routed jobs, and no task_device_bindings requiring the old device.
project_binding.rebind_online_rule: Explicit rebind requires old device ONLINE and clean/no-active-work confirmation, unless project has never executed a task.
project_binding.offline_rebind: Forbidden in V2-BD. Offline-device migration requires a separate prospectively locked migration protocol.
project_binding.revoked_rebind: Forbidden in V2-BD for projects with prior task/worktree state.
project_binding.direct_project_register_guard: After the first execution device is paired, legacy project_register is rejected DEVICE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED; use project_register_on_device.

task_binding.inheritance: task_create copies current project_device_bindings.device_id + binding_generation into task_device_bindings in the same central transaction.
task_binding.task_tool_routing: Every task-scoped read/mutation/job command resolves device from task_device_bindings; caller-supplied device_id is not accepted.
task_binding.claim_git_worktree: task_claim validates device ONLINE before claim phase1 and routes TASK_WORKTREE_ENSURE to that bound device before RUNNING.
task_binding.offline_during_claim: Durable claim/worktree command remains tied to same device. If task lease expires, task becomes RECOVERABLE; command may not perform stale mutation after command/task expiry.
task_binding.no_silent_migration: Task device binding never changes for the lifetime of the task, including OFFLINE/REVOKED conditions.

routed_operations.reads: Task-scoped routed reads are retryable and never mutate node state except bounded command-journal/cache metadata.
routed_operations.mutations: Gateway validates current task lease/epoch before creating command and binds operation_id+request_hash+task binding+route_generation.
routed_operations.filesystem_containment: Node resolves all project/task paths under local MCP_NODE_ROOT and local project binding; symlink/path escape rejected.
routed_operations.execution_env: Node injects REMOTEMCP_DEVICE_ID and REMOTEMCP_PROJECT_ID into task-bound job environment for diagnostics/qualification; these variables are not routing authority.

node_cas_intent_journal.recovery: On node restart, compare current target hash/temp hash against expected_before_hash/intended_after_hash. Never blindly repeat a filesystem replacement.
node_cas_intent_journal.lease_expiry_boundary: If replacement has not happened and the routed mutation command is expired or its central task lease is no longer valid, node must not perform a new replace. If replacement already happened, node may only finalize/replay evidence.

routed_jobs.submit: task_job_submit returns central proxy_job_id after node durably creates local V2-A job and reports node_job_id.
routed_jobs.generic_v2a_job_tools: Gateway-local V2-A job_* stay local. Remote task jobs are observed/cancelled through task_jobs/task_job_cancel and routed-job proxy metadata.
routed_jobs.offline_behavior: If device becomes OFFLINE, proxy preserves last_known_state and reports device_state=OFFLINE. It is not marked FAILED/LOST and is not relaunched elsewhere.
routed_jobs.node_restart: Node local V2-A supervisor reconciles its process. On reconnect it reports same proxy_job_id/node_job_id and current terminal/running state.
routed_jobs.revoke_behavior: Existing remote job state becomes unreachable/unknown from gateway; metadata preserved. No kill or migration is assumed.
routed_jobs.node_v2a_operation_id: Deterministic local V2-A operation_id = v2bd-node-job:<device_id>:<command_id>. JOB_SUBMIT replay queries/reuses that operation/job rather than launching a second payload.

public_observation.task_jobs: Cached list of routed-job proxy metadata; never requires device online.
public_observation.task_job_get: If refresh=True and device ONLINE, route JOB_GET and update cached proxy state; if OFFLINE, return cached state plus device_state=OFFLINE.
public_observation.task_job_logs: Route bounded JOB_LOGS to bound device; OFFLINE returns DEVICE_OFFLINE and never falls back to gateway-local job logs.
public_observation.task_job_result: Route JOB_RESULT when ONLINE; terminal cached result may replay centrally once persisted. OFFLINE with no cached terminal result returns DEVICE_OFFLINE.
public_observation.gateway_v2a_job_tools: job_get/job_logs/job_result remain gateway-local and MUST reject rjob_* with ROUTED_JOB_USE_TASK_TOOLS.

public_tools.device_pair_begin: async def device_pair_begin(operation_id: str, device_name: str) -> dict
public_tools.device_revoke: async def device_revoke(operation_id: str, device_id: str, reason: str = '') -> dict
public_tools.project_register_on_device: async def project_register_on_device(operation_id: str, device_id: str, path: str, max_active_tasks: int = 4) -> dict
public_tools.project_bind_device: async def project_bind_device(operation_id: str, project_id: str, device_id: str) -> dict
public_tools.task_list_dir: async def task_list_dir(task_id: str, path: str = '.') -> dict
public_tools.task_read_file: async def task_read_file(task_id: str, path: str, offset: int = 0, limit: int = 120000) -> dict
public_tools.task_search: async def task_search(task_id: str, pattern: str, path: str = '.') -> dict
public_tools.task_job_get: async def task_job_get(task_id: str, proxy_job_id: str, refresh: bool = True) -> dict

public_tools.task_job_result: async def task_job_result(task_id: str, proxy_job_id: str) -> dict

compatibility.existing_v2b_tools: agent/session/task lease semantics remain central. task_create/task_claim/file_write_cas/file_edit_cas/task_job_submit/task_jobs/task_job_cancel become device-routed internally when task binding points to an execution node.
compatibility.gateway_local_mode: Before any device is paired, current V2-B local behavior remains available.
compatibility.legacy_list_read_search: Remain gateway-local compatibility tools and are never used for remote managed task paths.
compatibility.legacy_run_command_direct_job_submit: Remain subject to existing managed-mode V2-B guards.
compatibility.routed_job_guard: Gateway-local job_get/job_wait/job_logs/job_result/job_cancel reject rjob_* proxy IDs with ROUTED_JOB_USE_TASK_TOOLS. Remote jobs use task_job_get/task_job_logs/task_job_result/task_job_cancel.

node_runtime.root_rule: Every bound project path must canonicalize under MCP_NODE_ROOT. Qualification roots must be newly created isolated directories and must not equal a research workspace.
node_runtime.durable_job_engine: Reuse existing V2-A DurableService inside the node with workspace_root=MCP_NODE_ROOT and runtime_dir=<MCP_NODE_RUNTIME_DIR>/durable. Node routing state remains in node.db.
node_runtime.single_process_lock: Node agent holds an exclusive OS advisory lock on <MCP_NODE_RUNTIME_DIR>/node.lock. A second local process using the same runtime fails NODE_ALREADY_RUNNING.

observability.immediate: device_list/device_status expose state, last_seen, route_generation, bound project count, active command count and routed-job counts.
observability.ops_successor: Existing /ops observability successor must add Device above Project: Device -> Project -> Task -> Agent/Session -> Job.

real_two_execution_device_qualification.isolation_rule: Use newly created pilot roots/runtime directories on both physical machines. Do not bind ArcLLM/CQG/SIX or any existing research repo during V2-BD qualification.
preconditions: both ChatGPT login-device sessions already proven under same owner account
both machines have outbound HTTPS access to remote.threadon.xyz
gates: pair machine 1 and machine 2 as two distinct execution devices with distinct dev_* IDs and Ed25519 fingerprints
both devices ONLINE concurrently for at least 2 offline TTL windows
register one isolated pilot Git project on each device
project A binding == device A; project B binding == device B
create task on each project and verify immutable inherited task-device binding
routed task_read_file/list/search return only content from the correct physical machine
CAS write on task A changes only machine-A pilot tree; CAS write on task B changes only machine-B pilot tree
task_job_submit on each device returns REMOTEMCP_DEVICE_ID matching the bound device
cross-route negative: no command for project/task A is executed by device B and vice versa
stop node agent on machine 2; within 60s it becomes OFFLINE while machine 1 remains ONLINE
new command for machine 2 returns DEVICE_OFFLINE and is not reassigned to machine 1
machine-1 task continues working while machine 2 is offline
restart same machine-2 node identity; OFFLINE->ONLINE without new device_id and without duplicate command execution
run a durable job on machine 2, restart node agent, reconnect and observe same proxy_job_id/node_job_id to terminal state
for a routed job, verify task_job_get/task_job_logs/task_job_result resolve through the bound execution device and never gateway-local V2-A job storage
replay the same signed device nonce and verify DEVICE_REPLAY
send stale timestamp and verify DEVICE_SIGNATURE_STALE
redeliver same command_id/request_hash and prove node replays stored result without duplicate side effect
send same command_id with different request_hash and verify COMMAND_CONFLICT
send a validly signed request with stale route_generation and verify DEVICE_ROUTE_GENERATION_MISMATCH
inject node CAS crash after atomic replace before routed command result; restart same node and prove intended hash is finalized without a second filesystem write
at qualification end create a disposable extra pairing identity, revoke it, and verify REVOKED is terminal without revoking either primary test device
real_two_execution_device_qualification.pass_rule: Every gate passes once with frozen code/config; no selective rerun to rescue a failed routing assertion. Infrastructure-only retry is allowed only after documenting an external transport interruption before any affected command outcome was observed.
real_two_execution_device_qualification.production_cutover_rule: V2-BD implementation may be developed against production gateway only after implementation lock and isolated pilot preflight. Real research projects remain unbound until V2-BD qualification PASS.

prelock_forbidden: create devices rows in production DB
pair either physical machine as execution node
bind any real/research project to a device

reason: PROJECT_REGISTER_ON_DEVICE requires two ordered routed commands under one high-level operation, so UNIQUE(operation_id) would be incorrect.
Remote FILE_WRITE_CAS/FILE_EDIT_CAS need a node-local intent journal to reconcile crash after atomic replace before result persistence.
prelock_amendment_before_implementation_.node_runtime_change: Freeze a dedicated <MCP_NODE_RUNTIME_DIR>/durable subruntime that reuses V2-A DurableService for local process durability while node.db owns routing/idempotency state.
prelock_amendment_before_implementation_.routed_job_api_gap: Added task_job_get/task_job_logs/task_job_result because gateway-local V2-A job observation tools cannot safely observe rjob_* on remote execution nodes.
prelock_amendment_before_implementation_.pairing_cli_hardening: Pairing secret moved from argv to one-time --code-file to avoid process-list/shell-history disclosure.
prelock_amendment_before_implementation_.pairing_response_replay: Added device_pairings.code_nonce + runtime-local device-pairing.key so a lost device_pair_begin response can replay the same clear code without persisting that code.
